source_name: Banka Slovenije — Upravljavci plačilnih sistemov (register of payment system operators)
why_relevant: Authoritative register naming every licensed payment-system operator in SI (Bankart, Activa/Intesa-operated system, etc.). Best pointer for keeping the actor map of switches/schemes current, and for detecting entries/exits.

source_name: SPOT / eVEM — licensing register for cash transport and valuables protection (prevoz in varovanje gotovine)
why_relevant: Defines the regulated activity and licence requirements for cash-in-transit in Slovenia (own or contracted monitoring centre, liability insurance, premises in Slovenia, at least one CIT vehicle). Establishes the universe of legally eligible CIT bidders — the set of companies that can win a Slovenian cash-transport tender — and the compliance criteria those tenders will cite.

source_name: SPOT / eVEM - Prevoz in varovanje gotovine ter drugih vrednostnih posiljk (regulated activity and licence pages)
why_relevant: The authoritative definition of the CIT activity and its licence conditions, and the entry point that names the competent authority (Ministry of the Interior), the licence certificate, and the legal prerequisites (a permanently employed security manager, trained personnel, specially adapted vehicles). It anchors the correct legal terminology for every downstream search and points onward to the licence register, the governing act and the implementing rulebook. Essential for building the cell's glossary correctly rather than searching on colloquial terms.

source_name: ZBS — Članice (member directory: banks, savings banks, leasing companies)
why_relevant: Authoritative actor map: lists member banks/savings banks (NLB, SKB, OTP, Intesa Sanpaolo, UniCredit, Addiko, Sparkasse, BKS, Delavska hranilnica, Direktna banka, SID, GB, Ljubljanska banka, Probanka) and a separate leasing-company tier (BKS Leasing, DH Leasing, Mobilize Financial Services, Toyota/Volvo/Scania Finance, SKB Leasing, Sparkasse Leasing, NLB Lease&Go). The leasing tier reveals consumer-finance actors that a pure bank register does not label.

source_name: ZBS — ABC bančnih izrazov (banking terminology glossary) + FAQ for bank customers
why_relevant: Authoritative SL↔EN banking/payments glossary maintained by the association — the cleanest way to build the local-language query vocabulary (kartično poslovanje, plačilna kartica, bankomat, POS terminal, provizija, takojšnja plačila) used across every other source in this run.

source_name: SiStat PxWeb API help / documentation (Pomoč pri uporabi API-ja)
why_relevant: Documents the exact endpoints, request shapes, rate limits and output formats (PX, CSV, JSON, XLSX, JSON-stat) needed to build a durable automated collector against SiStat, plus the changelog API for update detection.

entity_name: AJPES main portal and Katalog informacij javnega značaja
source_name: AJPES main portal and Katalog informacij javnega značaja
why_relevant: Enumerates every register and public service AJPES operates (PRS, JOLP, eVPO, RNO, statistical surveys), which is the fastest way to discover further structured datasets relevant to merchant and financial-entity mapping.

entity_name: AJPES main portal and Katalog informacij javnega značaja
source_name: AJPES – ePRS, Poslovni register Slovenije (Slovenian Business Register search)
why_relevant: Central public database of every business entity registered in Slovenia, freely accessible since 17 Oct 2014. Lets you resolve a licensed PSP name to matricna stevilka (registration no.), tax no., NACE/SKD activity, address, representatives and owners — the join key between the BS licence registers and filed financial statements. Also allows SKD-activity sweeps to find ATM/POS servicing companies that hold no payment licence.

entity_name: AJPES main portal and Katalog informacij javnega značaja
source_name: AJPES – Register dejanskih lastnikov (RDL, beneficial ownership register)
why_relevant: Ultimate-beneficial-owner data for Slovenian business entities under ZPPDFT-1; would reveal who actually controls small PSPs, ATM deployers and terminal resellers. Access, however, was materially narrowed as of 09.08.2025 following ZPPDFT-1 amendments, so it is a conditional rather than open source.

source_name: GZS — Združenja / zbornice dejavnosti (branch association directory)
why_relevant: Master index of ~30 GZS branch chambers, each a potential sector-specific source. For payments the relevant nodes are PTZ (trade), ZIT (informatics & telecoms — where payment-tech vendors and integrators sit), Zbornica poslovno storitvenih dejavnosti, Zbornica računovodskih servisov (fiscalisation/POS-software angle) and Združenje zavarovalnih posrednikov. Snowball entry point.

source_name: GZS – Trgovinska zbornica Slovenije (Chamber of Commerce, trade section): current trade statistics
why_relevant: The merchants' own trade association: publishes curated current trade statistics, sector position papers and is the counterparty in policy debates on cash acceptance obligations and interchange/terminal costs. A prime pointer to merchant sentiment and to further merchant-side data.

source_name: Nexi Slovenija d.o.o. (formerly Nets CEE / Intesa Sanpaolo Card) — company records
why_relevant: Business-register aggregator record for the SI arm of the Nexi processing group (activity code 63.100, parent Nexi Croatia d.o.o. za kartično poslovanje). Gives legal identity, ownership chain, headcount and filed financials for the largest international processor present in SI.

source_name: Comtrade programske rešitve d.o.o. (Ljubljana) — SI software house serving finance
why_relevant: Comtrade's Slovenian entity (Letališka cesta 29B, Ljubljana; ~310 staff, ~EUR 42m revenue 2024) is a significant local software supplier whose corporate registry footprint and bank-account relationships (NLB, OTP banka) confirm financial-sector exposure. Registry/credit portals are the pointer that lets you size otherwise-private vendors before hunting their reference pages.

source_name: Bizi.si / CompanyWall.si / eBonitete.si — Slovenian company registries with per-bank branch (poslovne enote) listings
why_relevant: Commercial registry aggregators republish AJPES-derived data including each bank's registered poslovne enote (branch establishments) and filed financials. This is an independent cross-check on self-reported branch counts and a way to date branch closures during the OTP network consolidation.

source_name: ZPJS — Zakon o plačilnih in javnofinančnih storitvah (payment services for budget users / UJP)
why_relevant: Governs how payment and public-finance services are provided to direct and indirect state budget users and municipalities, and includes provisions on contracting authorities reporting executed payments under procurement contracts. Explains WHY certain bank/payment services for the public sector are routed via UJP rather than tendered on the open market — critical for correctly interpreting the absence of bank-service tenders on the portal.

source_name: PISRS — Pravilnik o načinu prevoza in varovanja gotovine ter drugih vrednostnih pošiljk
why_relevant: The binding rulebook setting methods, minimum conditions and security measures for transferring, transporting and protecting cash. Slovenian CIT and ATM-replenishment tenders reference these categories directly, so it supplies the controlled vocabulary (transport classes, vehicle/escort requirements) needed to parse tender specifications correctly.

source_name: Informacijski pooblaščenec RS — inšpekcijski nadzor / prijava kršitev (enforcement channel)
why_relevant: Pointer to IP's inspection and sanction stream and to its annual report, which aggregates inspection counts by sector including finance/banking — a weak-signal indicator of systemic data practices in payments.

source_name: ASEE / Asseco South Eastern Europe — Slovenia entity and banking offering
why_relevant: ASEE runs a registered Slovenian entity (Litostrojska cesta 44c, Ljubljana) and sells omnichannel/banking software across SEE; its group structure and services pages are the entry point to case studies naming regional bank clients. Confirms an in-country vendor presence competing for SI bank software work.

source_name: denar.svetidej.com — Slovenian fintech services directory (Open Banking, mBills entries)
why_relevant: Local-language consumer directory of Slovenian fintech services and open-banking explainers; valuable purely as an actor-discovery index for smaller wallet/A2A players and for local terminology, not as an evidence source.

source_name: Open Banking Tracker — Slovenia country page
why_relevant: Third-party aggregator enumerating Slovenian ASPSPs, their API portals and licensed TPPs. Useful as a snowball index to discover bank developer portals and fintechs we would otherwise miss; figures should be verified against BSI/EBA registers rather than trusted directly.

source_name: SICRIS / COBISS CRIS — Slovenian current research information system
why_relevant: National registry of SI research organisations, researchers, projects and bibliographies. The systematic way to enumerate every SI academic/think-tank output on plačilni sistemi, kartično poslovanje and fintech — a pointer that snowballs into authors, institutes and funded projects.

source_name: Sloexport — Database of Slovenian Exporters (company cards incl. BANKART d.o.o.)
why_relevant: Export-directory company cards describe what SI payments/IT firms actually sell abroad and to whom, which surfaces vendor-side capability and market claims (e.g. Bankart's regional processing) that are otherwise only on marketing pages. Useful as a systematic list of SI banking-technology suppliers to then chase for references.
